meta.generated_by: gen_map.py (rules and tables; regenerate, do not edit by hand). Generator and document builder are kept outside the repository until work item FLT-22 commits them under tools/.
meta.param_convention: param is the value key (flat params object of 02_architecture.md section 3.2) that carries the legacy control value; key.member addresses one part of a parameter (a checkbox of a group, the mode radio or the picker of an office scope or scoped selection, a button). parameters[].value_keys lists the keys a parameter contributes to params. param_type action marks a legacy button: it is never a parameter.
meta.override_convention: mappings[] holds one mapping per signature. control_overrides[control_id] replaces param, param_type, option_map, status and notes for that one control and gives its default directly; apply it after the signature mapping. A control without an override takes the mapping of its signature.
meta.rule_convention: enabled_when[control_id] holds the enabling rule of a control (captured = greyed for the 53 controls captured greyed out, enabled for rules on controls captured enabled); expr is the stored form of the string. option_enabled_when[control_id][option_value] holds the rule of one option of an enabled group. rules[] holds visible / required / forced / default / label rules per report. The expression unknown (stored ["unknown"]) evaluates as true and must be resolved before the definition is published.
meta.token_convention: default_map and control_overrides write tokens as bare names (today, working_office, first_option, all, none, current_account, current_patient_name); a report definition writes context tokens as {"token": name} and range defaults as a preset.
